decisions.reason: A 2018 schlager compilation CD is likely outdated and declining in sales, making it a candidate for discontinuation.
The illustrated music release series from 2018 is likely past its peak and may be discontinued to free resources for newer projects.
Reissued jazz vinyl LPs continue to attract collectors and benefit from the vinyl revival, so likely kept.
Multi-disc box sets are typically limited-time collectibles and likely have little ongoing demand after three years.
As a generic compilation CD with limited website presence, it is likely a low-priority product that can be dropped.
